items.title: Godfrey Hirsch Interview, 1987-10-27
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] That's when you went into the Sanger Tour. Yeah.

ctx.x: So, I didn't know how to read, but I mean...I didn't have to read. I knew the damn stuff I thought. But it was funny. It's a funny situation. It was really something else. So I was a kid. I was only 24 years old. I was a kid.
That's when you went into the Sanger Tour. Yeah.

I was at the Jung Hotel with Alice Stratikas. That used to be a beautiful place, the roof garden. I think they used to charge you 50 cents or a dollar for a drink or something like that. Dance all night for a dollar and a half or two dollars. Beautiful room. They used to have a ceiling in it that used to slide over and you could see the sky right from the top. They don't have it anymore up there, I don't think.
